name: DIII-D
source: Coil elements: Fusion Equilibrium Challenge input files (diii_d_train), see scripts/build_machine_files.py. R0, TF turns and wall box: public machine facts.
wall_box_note: Inner wall 1.016 m, outer wall about 2.37 m, floor and roof about +-1.37 m.
column_scale_note: All columns at face value (kA x turns). The E coil (ohmic coil) is one rectangle in the challenge geometry and its true scale is not known; per-coil gains fitted on labelled DIII-D training shots are not part of this package.
